title: Ladies Day 2025
subtitle: A season of Southwest Division Ladies Days, club by club, through 2025.

sections.heading: April 9, 2025 — Newport Harbor LBC
body: Our first day of Ladies Day this year was hosted by Newport Harbor and their hospitality outdid themselves. Breakfast items in the morning and a great selection for lunch. A big thank you to Bobby Milas and Mike Ruggles for taking care of the greens, rolling, marking tees and setting everything up for us to play. Heather Stewart, the Head Coach for SWD demonstrated the correct way to lay your mat and also how to measure bowls from the green, as well as in the ditch. This was a beautiful presentation and we thank her for sharing her knowledge. Our motto is the more the merrier and we had 54 Ladies from 9 different clubs attending this time.
The following ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time ever and we hope to continue seeing them:

The Groves: Sheila Beingessner; From Laguna Beach: Carina Ormond and Kim Zebot;
Laguna Woods: Kelley Lacey and Rosemary Scholl; From Newport Harbor: Bonnie O’Donnel
Santa Ana: Angela Laws and Terri Bisch. 
WOW, 8 Ladies joining us for the first time.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played, and the winners were:
1 st Place: Roberta Morrison Cindy Jones Rosemary Scholl
2 nd Place: Inger Benson Karen Shorr Deborah Long
3rd Place: Maryna Hyland Julie Kimura Angela Laws
4 th Place: Heather Stewart Eleanor Reafsnyder Peggy Torrance
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1 st Place: Joan Narmontas Maureen Farris Barbara Perry
2nd Place: Phyllis Mitchell Karen Shorr Tracy Simons
3 rd Place: Norma Goodhart Barbara Hardesty Molly Smulian
4 th Place: Cindy Pham Catherine Early Kim Zebot
Congratulations to all the winners.

Next month Oaks North (San Diego) will be hosting Ladies Day on Wednesday, May 14th. A little further for many but the ladies from Oaks North travel to us all the time so let’s show them our support and travel their way. Hope to see you there.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: May 14, 2025 — Oaks North LBC
body: Oaks North hosted our Ladies Day and their hospitality was amazing. Upon arrival there were breakfast items and juices. For lunch we had a beautiful taco bar with all the fixings, really a special treat for everyone. I certainly can’t miss talking about the dessert variety and the bottled water they provided for all the bowlers. The weather was perfect for lawn bowling. Everyone was commenting how much fun it was to bowl amongst the 32 women who attended.
Nine clubs wererepresented: Casta del Sol, Coronado, Hermosa Beach, Laguna Beach, Laguna Woods, Newport Harbor, Oaks North, Santa Ana and San Diego.
The following ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time ever and we hope to continue seeing them: Michelle Matthews from Coronado and Patty Allen from Oaks North.
And now for our bowling results.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Sharon Barrington Jeri DeCastro Janet Atkin
2nd Place: Julie Kimura Kelley Lacey Kim Zebot
3rd Place tie: Phyllis Gould Nancy Santos Melinda Riddle
3rd Place tie: Jann Bagley Michelle Matthews Barbara Hardesty
The afternoon game of 10 ends winners were:
1st Place: Jann Bagley Kelley Lacey Angela Laws
2nd Place: Victoria Draper Madeline Wilson Kim Zebot
3rd Place tie: Irene Myrwold Karen Shorr
3rd Place tie: Kim Davis Catherine Early Terri Bisch
Congratulations to all the winners
Next month the Groves in Irvine will be hosting Ladies Day on June 11th - See you there!

sections.heading: June 19, 2025 — The Groves LBC
body: June 19, 2025 LADIES DAY

The Groves hosted our Ladies Day and their hospitality was amazing. Upon arrival there were breakfast items and juices. For lunch they served salad and desserts. The weather was perfect for lawn bowling. We filled the greens with 48 wonderful women. The 10 clubs represented were: Beverly Hills, Casta del Sol, The Groves, Holmby, Laguna Beach, Laguna Woods, Long Beach, Newport Harbor, Oaks North and Santa Ana.

The following ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time ever and we hope to continue seeing them: Felicia Varela from Beverly Hills; Maggie Lembo from Long Beach and Holly Lincoln, Jenn Selcho, Lisa Helleland and Angie Mastroni from Newport Harbor. Most of these ladies joined SW Division within the last 3 months.
And now for our bowling results.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Irene Myrwold, Kelley Lacey, Barbara Parry, Terri Bisch
2nd Place: Charlyn Moltane, Myra Farrell, Deborah Long, Angela Laws
3rd Place: Doreen Hall, Kathy Harrington, Jenn Selcho
The afternoon game of 10 ends winners were:
1st Place: Doreen Hall, June “Kiwi” Ralph, Merrill Stanton
2nd Place: Sandra Mironesco, Diane Wenzel, Molly Smulian
3rd Place: Julie Buchanan, Holly Gross, Amy Ding
Congratulations to all the winners!
A huge thank you to Norma Goodhart for helping Diana when Shelley could not be there. Also thank you to Doreen Hall for taking pictures.
Next month Newport Harbor will be hosting Ladies Day on July 9th. Hope to see you there.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: July 9, 2025 — Newport Harbor LBC
body: July 9, 2025 LADIES DAY

Newport Harbor LBC hosted our Ladies Day and their hospitality was amazing. Breakfast consisted of the delicious deviled eggs made by Eleanor Reafsnyder, and others brought fruit, bagels and cream cheese and desserts. Lunch was also plentiful with several salads, jello mold and other goodies. Thank you to all the ladies who participated in bringing food for this day and to those who helped with the hospitality setting up all the food. A special thank you to John Laws who helped setting up the greens and helping throughout the day.
Ten clubs were represented and 48 Ladies attended: Casta del Sol, Hermosa Beach, Holmby, Laguna Beach, Laguna Woods, Long Beach, Newport Harbor, Oaks North, Santa Ana and The Groves.

Thank you Heather Stewart for your teaching demonstration of delivery of your bowl. 
Welcome to Esther Lee from Hermosa Beach attending Ladies Day for the first time.
And now for our bowling results.
In the morning, 12 ends were played, and the winners were:
1st Place: Karen Billon, Elena Kraus, Barbara Parry
2nd Place: Heather Stewart, Cindy Jones, Merrill Stanton
3rd Place tie: Jann Bagley, Charlyn Moltane, Diane Prior
3rd Place tie: Jeri DeCastro, Catherine Early, Jenn Selcho
The afternoon game of 10 ends, and the winners were:
1st Place: Karen Billon, Patty Doidge, Tracy Simons
2nd Place: Jeri DeCastro, Janell Williams
3rd Place tie: Shelley Cohen, Joan Narmontas, Molly Smulian
3rd Place tie: Susan Denton, Myra Farrell, Merrill Stanton
3rd Place tie: Irene Myrwold, Barbara Parry
Congratulations to all the winners
A special thanks to Norma Goodhart, who once again helped with Ladies Day as Diana recovers from surgery on her arm.
Next month, Laguna Beach will be hosting Ladies Day on August 12th. Hope to see you there.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators & Norma Goodhart

sections.heading: August 13, 2025 — Laguna Beach LBC
body: August 13, 2025 LADIES DAY
August 13, 2025 - Ladies Day at Laguna Beach

Laguna Beach hosted our August ladies day and once again showed us wonderful hospitality. They had a beautiful assortment for breakfast, great salads for lunch and desserts including Heather Stewart’s heavenly hash. The greens were set up and ready for our large crowd to have a fabulous day on the greens.

A big thank you to all the ladies who participated in Ladies Day. There were 57 ladies from 12 different SW Division clubs. We all had a fun day bowling. The clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol LBC, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Oaks North LBC, San Diego LBC, Santa Ana LBC, Santa Monica LBC and The Groves LBC.

The following ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time and we hope to continue seeing them: From Long Beach LBC; Vicki Wong an Amy Toy, From Newport Harbor LBC; Lisa Morrone and Tracy Rath, From San Diego LBC; Christine Edlund and Suzanne deLong.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Joanne Hedgespeth, Diane Prior and Kathy Becker
2nd Place: Kathy Yezarski, Diana Wenzel and Suzanne DeLong
3rd Place: Maureen Schulte, Merrill Stanton and Vickie Wong
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Janice Lavelle, Diane Reynolds, Sheila Beingesser and Jenn Selcho
2nd Place: Tory Ruppert, Norma Goodhart and Aileen Broccardo
3rd Place: Joan Narmontas, Claudia Sego, Janelle Williams and Cindie Chafe
Congratulations to all the winners.

Next month Hermosa Beach LBC will be hosting Ladies Day on Wednesday, September 10th. Hope to see you there. Your club should have the sign up sheet posted or you can rsvp by email to: swladiesday@gmail.com
Thanks again for making Ladies Day such a success
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: September 10, 2025 — Hermosa Beach LBC
body: September 10, 2025 - Ladies Day at Hermosa Beach LBC

Hermosa Beach LBC hosted our September Ladies day and welcomed us with open arms. Their hospitality was absolutely amazing, starting with a fabulous assortment for breakfast (many homemade) and then a beautiful luncheon buffet.

A big thank you to all the ladies who participated in Ladies Day. There were 44 ladies from 11 different SW Division clubs. Everyone enjoyed their games and friendships. The clubs joining us for the day were Beverly Hills LBC, Casta del Sol LBC, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Santa Ana LBC, Santa Monica LBC and The Groves LBC.
The following ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time and we hope to continue seeing them: From Hermosa Beach, Kathy Welch, Shara Montana and Bunny Halter, From Long Beach, Christine Baratta.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Phyllis Mitchell, Gale Gellerman, Sheila Beingessner
2nd Place: Maureen Schulte, Terri Bisch and Shara Montana
3rd Place: Claudia Sego, Sally Chateau and Patti Giglio
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Kelly Lacey, Gale Gellerman and Christine Baratta
2nd Place: Inger Benson and Roberta Morrison
3rd Place: Diane Prior, Linda Bator and Sheila Beingessner
Congratulations to all the winners.

Next month Casta Del Sol LBC will be hosting Ladies Day on Wednesday, October 8th. Hope to see you there. Your club should have the sign-up sheet posted or you can rsvp by email to: swladiesday@gmail.com
Thanks again for making Ladies Day such a success
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: October 8, 2025 — Casta del Sol Lawn Bowling Pavilion
body: October 8, 2025 - Ladies Day at Casta del Sol Lawn Bowling Pavilion

Casta del Sol hosted our Ladies Day, and their hospitality was amazing. Upon arrival, there were delicious sweets, deviled eggs, and fruit. For lunch, we had a wonderful variety of salads and amazing homemade desserts. The hospitality greeted us with open arms and even supplied bottled water. Ten clubs were represented: Casta del Sol, Holmby, Laguna Beach, Laguna Woods, Long Beach, Newport Harbor, San Diego, Santa Ana, The Groves, and a guest, Michele Lary, visiting from Pittsburgh, PA. So nice to welcome out-of-towners to bowl with us. Another newcomer to our Ladies Day was Kathryn Williams from Casta del Sol.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning, 12 ends were played, and the winners were:
1st Place: Doreen Hall, Terri Bisch, Val Blackholly
2nd Place: Phyllis Mitchell, Chris Adams, Janell Williams
3rd Place tie: Joan Narmontas, Catherine Early, Amy Toy
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Norma Goodhart, Patty Doidge, Vicki Wong
2nd Place: Michele Lary, Tracy Simons, Deborah Long
3rd Place: Diane Wenzel, Merrill Stanton
2nd and 3rd Place was decided by a one-bowl roll-off with the Skips. Their plus points were tied.
Congratulations to all the winners.
Next month, Long Beach will be hosting Ladies Day on Wednesday, November 12th. Hope to see you there.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: November 12, 2025 — Long Beach LBC
body: November 12, 2025 - Ladies Day at Long Beach LBC

Ladies Day is always so much fun. Long Beach hosted our November Ladies Day, and their hospitality was fabulous. Everyone enjoyed their breakfast items and the great selection of salads and desserts for lunch.

We had 34 ladies from 8 different SW Division clubs. I am pleased to have many ladies talk about enjoying meeting ladies from different clubs and having such a good time. The clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol LBC, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, and Santa Ana LBC.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning, 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Phyllis Mitchell. Cindy Jones, Mary Sanchez
2nd Place: Linda Bator, Patty Doidge, Amy Toy
3rd Place: Catherine Early, Connie Delgado, Merrill Stanton
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Shelley Cohen, Diane Prior, Eleanor Reafsnyder
2nd Place: Diana Wenzel, Sandra Mironesco, Karen Shorr
3rd Place: Norma Goodhart, Vicki Wong, Kathy Becker
Congratulations to all the winners!

We have only one more Ladies Day for 2025. This is our big Holiday Luncheon held at Laguna Woods on Wednesday, December 17th. I hope to see a big group attending. Lots of fun with one game of bowling in the morning and then we have a luncheon. Everyone dresses in their fun and casual holiday attire. Everyone attending brings a wrapped gift and we sell opportunity drawing tickets to win these prizes. RSVP and payment of $25 payable to SWD must be received by December 10th. Hope to see you there.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: December 17, 2025 — Laguna Woods LBC
body: December 17, 2025 - Ladies Day Holiday Party

It is hard to believe this was our last event for 2025. The year flew by but with lots of fun at each Ladies Day. Our celebration was filled with joy, laughter and outstanding holiday outfits. Be sure you look at the pictures. Laguna Woods LBC welcomed everyone in the morning and provided delicious breakfast food to kick off our day. Off to the greens to have a spider game and Desiree Hamilton was the winner. We then bowled one game. After the game everyone went to Clubhouse 7 to enjoy a wonderful catered lunch and chit chat with each other. Our raffle prizes looked so festive on the table and many lucky winners enjoyed their prizes. A huge thank you to Heather Stewart who graciously donated a spectacular handmade quilted holiday runner. The lucky winner of this runner was Aileen Broccardo. This was such a special day to celebrate with each and everyone who attended.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
Our game winners were:
1st Place: Heather Stewart, Jenn Selcho, Sue Woods
2nd Place: Sheila Conti, Tracy Simons, Jackie Proctor
3rd Place: Tricia Quan, Merrill Stanton, Patty Somers
Congratulations to all the winners.
We will resume Ladies Day in April 2026. Merry Christmas, Happy Hannukah and a Very Happy New Year to all.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators
Joan Narmontas, co-chair of the luncheon

migrationNotes: Migrated from the Squarespace blog collection /ladies-day-2025, which held nine posts — one per Ladies Day. Each post became a prose section (its date and venue as the heading) followed by its gallery.
The post URL slugs are Squarespace leftovers ('junethegroves-ny8nh-b4pcg-4mklb…'); the post titles were real and are used for the headings.

The May 14 (Oaks North) post contains a second gallery block that repeats fourteen photographs from the April 9 (Newport Harbor) post — an editing slip on the source page. The duplicates have been carried across as they appear on the site rather than silently dropped: files 31–44 in photos/pages/ladies-day-2025 are the same pictures as files 02–15.
The June 19 (The Groves) post has only the two winners' graphics and no photographs of the day.
Squarespace's alt text on these images was just the file name, so all alt text here was written fresh from the pictures.
